newsitem.title: USA: Bay View restructures thrift & loan unit.
newsitem.headline: Bay View restructures thrift & loan unit.

text.p: Bay View Capital Corp said on Wednesday its California Thrift & Loan has agreed to sell its equipment leasing portfolio and will sell a portion of its auto loan portfolio.
Bay View, which previously announced it would restructure the thrift and loan, said its equipment leasing portfolio aggregated $60 million and were sold to Santa Barbara Bank & Trust for cash.
It said the sale of its auto loans should enable the thrift to return about $25 million of capital to the company.

Bay View, which is also the holding company for Bay View Federal Bank and Bay View Securitization Corp, said the completion of recent moves should allow its thrift to operate as a pure consumer finance company.
The company said it plans to use an estimated $48 million of capital being returned to the company to pursue acquisitions or repurchase additional shares.
